runs.note: ZERO-DRIFT RUN, the falsifying test the 513K question was waiting on. RM report 78 was pinned with asOfDate=2026-09-05 to match the warehouse snapshot instead of being pulled as-of-run. The gap collapsed from -512,889 at 1 day of drift to +76,531 at zero drift, so the bulk of it was timing across the grace day and Austin's read was right. The 76,531 residual is 6 reportable communities RM returns no AR rows for at all and 87 fewer accounts with a balance.

Can report 78 carry the trend history? No. asOfDate is honoured, but the report RECONSTRUCTS aging from the current ledger rather than reading a snapshot, so anything written off, reversed or settled since has vanished from the past. At the 2026-08-31 month end it returns 490,824 against the warehouse's real snapshot of 618,782, 21 pct light, on 283 accounts against 419. The 90+ bucket survives best at -5 pct (306,243 vs 323,119) because old money that is still old is still there; the recent buckets collapse (0-30 at 115,716). Rebuilding 20 months of trend this way would slope the 90+ line the wrong way for a reason that has nothing to do with operations.
